definitions.explanation: A razor powered by electricity, used for shaving facial hair or body hair without a blade directly touching the skin.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり}で{髭|ひげ}を{剃|そ}る。
examples.english: I shave my beard with an electric razor every morning.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}に{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり}をプレゼントした。
examples.english: I gave my father an electric razor for his birthday.

examples.japanese: {電気剃刀|でんきかみそり}は{肌|はだ}に{優|やさ}しいので、{敏感肌|びんかんはだ}の{人|ひと}にも{向|む}いている。
examples.english: Electric razors are gentle on the skin, so they are suitable even for people with sensitive skin.

notes:
{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり} is the full Japanese term, but the loanword シェーバー (from English "shaver") is more commonly used in everyday conversation and advertising. In product names, {電気|でんき}シェーバー and {電動|でんどう}シェーバー are also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気剃刀|でんきかみそり}の{替刃|かえば} — replacement blade for an electric razor
- {防水|ぼうすい}{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり} — waterproof electric razor
- {回転式|かいてんしき}{電気剃刀|でんきかみそり} — rotary electric razor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シェーバー — shaver (loanword; more common in daily speech)
- {剃刀|かみそり} — razor (manual, non-electric)
- T{字|じ}カミソリ — safety razor; T-shaped razor
